examples.explanation: Elements at even indices are nums[0] = 1 and nums[2] = 5 because 0 and 2 are even numbers. Elements at odd indices are nums[1] = 3 and nums[3] = 7 because 1 and 3 are odd numbers. The alternating sum is nums[0] - nums[1] + nums[2] - nums[3] = 1 - 3 + 5 - 7 = -4.
The only element at even indices is nums[0] = 100 because 0 is an even number. There are no elements on odd indices. The alternating sum is nums[0] = 100.
